outcome: Need for intensive care unit treatment for newborns
Need for mechanical ventilator support for newborns
cohort: 106 healthy pregnant women at term undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: While CNAP detected more hypotensive episodes and detected them faster than NIBP, it did not provide an additional advantage for healthy pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Continuous non-invasive arterial pressure monitoring during cesarean section under neuraxial anesthesia does not provide additional advantages in detecting hypotensive episodes compared to non-invasive blood pressure monitoring in healthy pregnant women.
